messages:
marina-support: FYI Acme GmbH (DE) opened a ticket — they need an invoice without VAT (reverse charge). They say their EU VAT ID is DE123456789 but our billing portal is failing validation. :thinking:

raj-billing: can you paste the exact value they provided? formatting matters (no spaces, country code required).

marina-support: they pasted `DE 123456789` with a space. I asked them to resend without spaces but they replied it's the number their finance team uses.

marina-support: ran a quick VIES lookup, got an error:```
{
  "Fault": {
    "faultstring": "MSISDN: Invalid country code",
    "detail": {
      "error": "INVALID_INPUT"
    }
  }
}
```

finance-bot: Automated note: customer has active subscription, last payment succeeded. No recent chargebacks.

raj-billing: hmm. VIES sometimes times out for DE numbers if the service is flaky. Ask customer to confirm VAT ID without spaces and try again, or provide their VAT validation certificate (pdf) from their tax authority.

marina-support: Acme attached a PDF but it's a scanned letter with low DPI. I tried OCR and got `DE123456789` but the fiscal number looks short — DE numbers are usually 9 digits but could vary.

lena-legal: A couple things: 1) For reverse charge we need a valid EU VAT ID and evidence of cross-border B2B use. 2) If VIES fails, we can accept a national VAT registration certificate from the customer (signed or digital) as backup. Need to record the evidence in the invoice metadata.

marina-support: customer insists their VAT is valid; they shared a screenshot from their German ERP showing VAT ID: DE123456789 and their company name: Acme GmbH, HRB 12345.

raj-billing: I'll try manual validation via the EU VIES web form (not API) and see if it returns a result. If still failing, we can escalate to compliance to accept the national registry doc.

raj-billing: manual VIES check returned status: "Validation service temporarily unavailable". Might be an EU-wide outage or rate limit.

marina-support: Customer asked if we can void VAT on the invoice now so they can pay. They have a PO and need payment terms.

lena-legal: Don't void VAT without evidence. Offer provisional invoice (showing VAT line but note "VAT to be reversed upon valid EU VAT ID confirmation") and extend payment window til we get docs.

acme-gmbh-billing: we can provide national VAT certificate from the German tax office. We'll upload it now. Apologies for the formatting confusion.

finance-bot: Upload received: acme_vat_cert_2026-03-10.pdf (scanned, 300 DPI).

raj-billing: Thanks. I'll attach it to the invoice record and mark invoice as "pending reverse charge documentation" and set a 14-day hold on payment application so accounting doesn't auto-apply VAT.

marina-support: Logged steps for the ticket and asked customer for contact email for their finance rep to confirm if needed.

lena-legal: After attaching the national certificate, we should add an internal note: source_of_validation: 'national_certificate', validation_date: 2026-03-10, validator: raj-billing, acceptance_reason: 'VIES unavailable but national registry doc provided matching company name and registration number'.

raj-billing: Marking done. I'll follow up with finance ops to ensure the tax engine won't re-add VAT when processing the payment.

marina-support: customer confirmed payment will be initiated once we send the provisional invoice. I'll update the ticket with provisional invoice link. :white_check_mark:

acme-gmbh-billing: thanks all, appreciate the help.

finance-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow up in 7 days if no final VAT validation record attached.
